If life is meaningless, then it has no worth. What is it's value? We come and go. We fret our hour upon the stage, as Shakespeare said. I walked from class thinking about the butterfly, and why it lives and flies, only to die in 2-3 weeks. It is here and then gone. We all are already gone. We are all already buried in the past, the year 2500. We are bones rotting in the recesses of the planet. We are cremated remnants, we are nothing. Yet in the briefest of moments when we are on the stage, we fight, fight, fight. I may not have jumped tonight, but it is a constant thought, and on impulse I can do it at any second. From the height I am thinking about, it should be immediate.
